body.x: LillyCover (CEO SunHee Ahn) participated in the Future Innovation Tech Expo 2024 (FIX 2024), held from October 23 to 26 at Daegu EXCO.

LillyCover is a beauty-tech startup that leverages ICT and BT technologies to deliver personalized cosmetics optimized for individual preferences and needs. The company aims to revolutionize the beauty industry by covering skin diagnostics, product formulation, manufacturing, and sales through advanced technology and extensive data collection.

The company focuses on compact formulation solutions and high-efficacy ingredients tailored to specific skin concerns. As part of its O2O offerings, it provides 1:1 personalized online care services. These specialized capabilities have drawn significant attention in the skincare solutions sector.
At FIX 2024, LillyCover showcased its AI, big data-powered hyper-personalized cosmetic solutions, and ENIMA Light, a compact automatic cosmetic dispensing system.

Launched in September last year, ENIMA Light has a downsized design that enables easy installation and operation in various spaces, including professional clinics and cosmetic stores. The system automatically formulates a diverse range of cosmetics tailored to individual users using extensive recipe data.

As an automated device, ENIMA Light minimizes space requirements and reduces labor costs associated with cosmetic formulation. It produces high-efficacy skincare products that address specific concerns, delivering premium quality and professional expertise. Remarkably, it takes only about three minutes to create a single product.

body.cap: LillyCover booth at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: In addition to ENIMA Light, LillyCover introduced complementary products like the Muilli skin and scalp diagnostic device. With AI algorithms and global skin big data comprising over 150,000 entries, Muilli achieves an impressive diagnostic accuracy of 98.3%. Designed for use with mobile devices, it is highly portable and versatile.

A LillyCover representative stated, “The cosmetic market, once dominated by a few prominent brands, is rapidly evolving with modern, advanced technologies driving the shift toward hyper-personalization. LillyCover is at the forefront of this transformation, diagnosing customer needs and instantly creating custom cosmetics based on data. We are injecting fresh energy into the cosmetic industry with our integrated solutions.”

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
